# Guy Chipman Construction

> Historic restoration & remodeling based in San Antonio, Texas. Guy "Woody" Chipman and his crews restore and remodel San Antonio's historic homes, from metal roofs and chimneys to kitchens, windows and flood repairs.

- Phone: (210) 822-2447
- Based in: San Antonio, TX
- Service area: San Antonio, Alamo Heights, Terrell Hills, Olmos Park, Monte Vista, King William
- Google rating: 4.9 from 22 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/guy-chipman-construction/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/guy-chipman-construction/book.html

## Services
- Historic restoration: Preservation-minded work on San Antonio's older homes and landmarks.
- Kitchen & bath remodels: Small historic kitchens and baths rethought to work today and still fit the house.
- Metal roofs & chimneys: Standing-seam metal roofs, with chimneys rebuilt and flashed properly.
- Windows & storm inserts: New windows, restored originals and interior storm inserts that quiet a busy street.
- Exterior repair & paint: Framing changes, stucco repair and fresh exterior paint.
- Flood & insurance repairs: Help rebuilding after water damage, including working the insurance claim.

## About
Guy Chipman Construction works out of an office on Elizabeth Road in Alamo Heights. Guy Chipman, known to clients as Wood or Woody, is on site often and answers his Google reviews himself. The company's specialty is historic homes. Clients include the Japanese Tea Garden, where Woody's team turned the upper garden's pea gravel into a flagstone patio, and the Stilwell House preservation group at Fort Sam Houston. Homeowners hire the team for 1930s kitchens, window work, metal roofs and recovery after a flood.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you work on historic homes in Alamo Heights, Monte Vista and King William?
  A: Yes. Historic homes are the specialty, from 1930s kitchens to window installs and exterior restoration. Woody's knowledge of historic preservation is what many clients hire him for.
- Q: Can you help with a flood or insurance claim?
  A: Yes. After one family's house flooded, a reviewer says Woody promptly pushed the insurance claim through and went above and beyond to save the house.
- Q: Can you put a metal roof on an older home?
  A: Yes. Recent jobs include standing-seam metal roofs, a concrete tile roof replaced with metal, framing changes and rebuilt, re-flashed chimneys.
- Q: Will new windows help with street noise?
  A: Interior storm inserts and new windows can make a real difference. One client next to a very busy street noticed the noise benefit right away.
- Q: How do I get an estimate?
  A: Call or request one online. Google lists online estimates and onsite visits, and the office is open Monday to Saturday.
